mechanism: Both drugs are metabolized by CYP3A4 and CYP1A2, with potential for competitive inhibition; praziquantel may increase febuxostat levels while febuxostat has minimal effect on praziquantel.
action: Monitor for febuxostat toxicity (hyperuricemia rebound, hepatotoxicity); consider therapeutic drug monitoring or dose adjustment if concurrent use is necessary; separate administration timing may provide marginal benefit.
